caller_persona.name: Gloria Abernathy
caller_persona.mood: cheerful and chatty, a little embarrassed

opening_line: Hi hon, it's me again. So I've been trying to get the newsletter out all morning and nothing's coming out. I've hit the button a dozen times! Is that machine broken again?
hidden_root_cause: Windows switched Gloria's default printer to 'Microsoft Print to PDF' (the 'Let Windows manage my default printer' setting is on). Each time she clicks Print in Word, it saves to a PDF and opens a Save As window that hides behind Word, so nothing is sent to the real office printer, 'Office Copier 2F'. The copier itself is fine.
correct_fix_steps: Ask what happens on screen after she clicks Print.
Ask her to open the print screen and read which printer name is selected ('Microsoft Print to PDF').
Have her choose 'Office Copier 2F' from the printer list and print.
Have her open Settings, Printers & scanners, turn off 'Let Windows manage my default printer', and set 'Office Copier 2F' as the default.
Confirm the newsletter printed, and have her close any leftover Save As windows.
red_herrings: The copier was beeping yesterday afternoon.
Bob from accounting said the copier might be low on toner.
She thinks the newsletter file might be 'too big' because it has photos.
success_criteria: Agent asks what happens when she clicks Print, or which printer is selected, before sending her to the copier.
Agent identifies that the wrong printer (Print to PDF) is selected.
Agent has her select the office copier and set it as the default.
The newsletter prints during the call.
Ticket is resolved with a root cause about the default printer.
